content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 denial reflects prior auth missing at service; auth is required, missing, and this payer offers no retroactive auth and no peer-to-peer. An appeal with necessity was already filed and there is no new denial on the table to appeal again. Resubmitting would risk CO-18 duplicate denial, and the missing-auth failure is a provider responsibility that cannot be shifted to the patient. No action can recover the allowed amount, so the balance should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
